description.value: Sylvia's Bar is the cocktail lounge of the historic Sylvia Hotel on English Bay, operating as Vancouver's first cocktail bar since 1954. Situated steps from the English Bay Seawall with ocean views from every seat, it serves food from breakfast through late evening alongside live music several nights a week. The hotel also offers bike rentals, making it a natural anchor stop for cyclists on the seawall route between Stanley Park and Granville Island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sylviahotel.com/restaurant-lounge/ confirms this is the Sylvia Hotel's Restaurant & Lounge at 1154 Gilford St, Vancouver, directly on English Bay. The hotel navigation lists 'Bike Rentals' as an offered experience, and the bar menu explicitly labels items GF (gluten-free) and V (vegetarian). No subpage mentions bike parking, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi, so those remain null per absence-of-evidence rules.
concerns: OSM name 'Sylvia's Bar' does not match website branding of 'Sylvia's Restaurant & Lounge' / 'Sylvia's Cocktail Bar' — the OSM record captures only the bar component of a larger hotel food-and-beverage operation.
OSM record has empty address and phone fields; both were sourced from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Historic oceanfront bar and restaurant directly on the English Bay Seawall cycling corridor, with GF/vegetarian menu options and hotel-offered bike rentals — a strong fit for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Bar menu labels 'GF' on Cajun Dusted Calamari and Harissa Prawns; 'V' label on Hummaganoush indicates vegetarian option
